newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Omnicare rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Omnicare rated buy.

text.p: -- CS First Boston analyst Howard Capek said he initiated coverage of Omnicare Inc with a buy rating.
-- estimated earnings of $0.60 per share for 1996 and $0.78 for 1997 versus $0.45 in 1995.
-- sees earnings per share growing 27 percent long-term, driven by same-store revenue growth of 16-20 percent and operating margin improvement of 4-5 percent.
-- said company "possesses one of the most flexible balance sheets across any health care sector, and perhaps the most attractive among the institutional pharmacy companies."
-- cited Omnicare as the industry leader in the institutional pharmacy services field.
